## Current Focus (as of 2026-07-05)

### Shipbuilding

- **Raft build** — planning the pine deck frame before permission to leave.
  Working from [[projects/active/raft/plan]] and the project registry at
  [[projects/active/raft/]]. Construction must wait for Calypso's tools.
- **Sail repairs** — splicing and sealing the second batch of cedar spars.

### Health

- Knee rehab is the open thread — see [[knee-injury]]. Next recovery appointment
  with Calypso is on the calendar; logging range-of-motion after each session.

### Navigation

- Working through the study course; [[star-bearings]] covers orientation before
  the night-sailing passage. Keep the Bear to the left.

### Loose ends

- Need to verify the eagle report from Ithaca. The note refers to
  [[does-not-exist]] until the omen register is created.
